protocol.selection: Every unique episode in the completed original audit failure list; outcome-selected diagnostic, not new held-out evidence.
protocol.replay: Chain saved executed feed and true-kappa intervals from the initial condition. Never reset to saved intermediate states; never optimize or change the executed policy.

implementations.amount: Frozen independent AmountReactor.interval; numerical globals overridden in memory only.
implementations.log: Frozen Reactor(fast=False).predict invokes its original uncompiled log-state RHS; only solve_ivp tolerances/max_step overridden in memory. Original analytic endpoint-volume correction retained.
implementations.rhs_consistency: At up to 33 uniformly spaced solver-node indices per interval of the finest uncompiled log replay, compare independently assembled rates and physical-amount derivatives. This is a finite sample, not a proof.

comparisons: Every arm versus saved primary endpoints
Original independent arm versus archived audit endpoints
Two finest formulations versus one another
protocol.interpretation_rule: Attribute a discrepancy as consistent with integration error only when both refinements and finest cross-formulation differences are materially smaller than the saved-to-refined discrepancy. Report all values even if nonmonotone; do not recategorize the original audit as passed.
limitations: Double precision and adaptive error estimators are not rigorous enclosures
Relative tolerances are above the SciPy roundoff floor, approximately 2.22e-14
Physical substrate minima are sampled at solver nodes, not globally certified
No online timing or controller-effectiveness inference

scope: Offline convergence diagnosis only. Original audit failure and original scientific outcomes retained.
